title: The Publish tour step says changes appear in Tracy right away and reach the live site on Publish, in every interface language
steps: S1: Run the script check: the English tour.publish.body in packages/ui/tracy-onboard/src/client/strings.ts starts with 'Your changes appear in Tracy right away', and each of the 7 tracy-onboard.json translations has a non-empty tour.publish.body that differs from the English.
evidence: Before this change the step said 'Visitors see your changes only after you press Publish', which new users read as nothing changing in Tracy until Publish.
fence: tour.publish.body in strings.ts and the seven locale files

cmd: const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('packages/ui/tracy-onboard/src/client/strings.ts','utf8');if(!s.includes('Your changes appear in Tracy right away'))process.exit(1);const files=['de','es','fr','it','nl','zh'].map(l=>'packages/locale/tracy-locales/'+l+'/tracy-onboard.json').concat(['packages/locale/tracy-locale-vi/vi/tracy-onboard.json']);for(const f of files){const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));const v=j['tour.publish.body']??j.tour?.publish?.body;if(!v||v.includes('Your changes appear'))process.exit(2)}
